items.text: The musical film Grease, starring John Travolta and Olivia Newton-John, was released on June 16, 1978.
items.question: Where did you see Grease, and who did you go with?
items.source_quote: June 16 – The musical film Grease is released, starring 24-year-old New Jersey born actor John Travolta and 29-year-old British-Australian actress and singer Olivia Newton-John.

items.text: The Bee Gees' "Stayin' Alive" reached number one on the Billboard Hot 100 in the issue dated February 4, 1978, and held the top spot for four weeks.
items.question: Where were you living when the Bee Gees' "Stayin' Alive" was on the radio, and where did you go dancing?
source_quote: The Billboard Hot 100 is a chart published since August 1958 by Billboard magazine which ranks the best-performing singles in the United States. In 1978, it was compiled based on a combination of sales and airplay data sourced from surveys of retail outlets and playlists submitted by radio stations, respectively. During the year, 20 different singles spent time at number one.
in the issue dated February 4, the Bee Gees returned to the top spot with "Stayin' Alive", which held the number-one position for four weeks.

items.text: The CBS soap opera Dallas began on April 2, 1978.
items.question: Who in your house watched Dallas, and which character did they love to hate?
items.source_quote: April 2 – The CBS soap opera Dallas is launched.

items.text: On October 17, 1978, the New York Yankees beat the Dodgers in Los Angeles to win the World Series, four games to two.
items.question: Where did you watch or listen to the 1978 World Series, and who were you rooting for?
items.source_quote: October 17 – The New York Yankees clinch their 22nd World Series championship, defeating the Dodgers 7–2 in Los Angeles and winning the Series 4 games to 2.
